_source: HEDB Data Dictionary 202601, sheet 'Institute - Research Projects'
_note: New 2026-10-26, built against Zoho_To_CHEDS_ (34).ds. raw_column values are the dictionary's 'Database Field Name' column verbatim, including its misspellings and trailing spaces. Zoho stores the DISPLAY text for every dropdown; the push workflow converts each back to its CHEDS code via subString() or a Dropdown_Fields function. HEDB 202601 marks removals by filling the row red: MOU_Number, Impact_indicator and Impact_Assessment are all struck, so the latter two are omitted entirely and MOU_Number is carried as reference-only. Individual codes struck in red inside a description are noted on the field concerned.

Multi-select. Each comma-separated Funding Source Type code becomes the exact Zoho choice text, re-joined with ', ' (e.g. 'G, HEI' -> 'Government, Higher Education Institutions'). The push converts it back via Dropdown_Fields.Funding_source_type().

Multi-select. Each comma-separated Frascati Field-of-R&D code becomes the exact Zoho choice text (e.g. '2.1, 3.5' -> 'Civil Engineering, Other Medical Sciences'). WARNING: the HEDB 'Fields of R&D' sheet numbers Nanotechnology 2.11 in one column and 2.10 in the other, and Excel stores both as floats so 2.10 reads back as '2.1' -- which collides with Civil Engineering. Both codes are accepted here as Nanotechnology; confirm the intended code with CHEDS.

fields._note: Raw code becomes the exact Zoho picklist text: 'C' -> 'Citation in government or international organization policy documents'; 'E' -> 'impact in terms of Speaking events with government officials'; 'A' -> 'research covers all of these impacts'; 'NA' -> 'not applicable'.

Pass-through with validation: the Zoho picklist now stores the CHEDS CODE itself (P / E / M / A / NA), so the code is written unchanged and the push sends rec.Public_outreach directly -- Dropdown_Fields.Public_outreach() is no longer used. An identity value_map is used rather than kind 'plain' so anything outside the five live codes is flagged in the Report. Codes 'C' (competition/prize) and 'R' (educational material) are deliberately ABSENT: HEDB 202601 strikes both, and the picklist no longer offers them, so a legacy C or R is reported as an error to fix at source instead of being written into a value Zoho would reject. NOTE: this field tracks the DEVELOPMENT environment -- see the config's _warning.
Reference only -- CHEDS says to send Last Updated ONLY through the master API. The Zoho form stamps lastUpdated itself on a successful push.

_warning: ENVIRONMENT MISMATCH -- READ BEFORE BUILDING. The Public_outreach mapping above matches the DEVELOPMENT environment of zoho-to-cheds, where the picklist was changed on 2026-10-26 to store bare CHEDS codes (P/E/M/A/NA). Production still holds the long descriptive choices until dev is published. Do NOT import a sheet built from this config into production before that publish, or every Public outreach value will be rejected. Three other fields are the reverse case: dev has already fixed Commercialization (code R removed), Funding_attraction (orphan choice removed) and International_Partner_Type (Healthcare/Community split, Technology Provider restored), but this config still carries the PRODUCTION shape for those three so today's production imports keep working. Update them in the same pass as the publish.
